title: The Alphabet and Weather
subtitle: Spelling your name and describing the day — for English learners

sentences.en: Hello! Can you spell your name for me, please?
sentences.target: Hello! Can you spell your name for me, please?

sentences.en: Sure. My name is Sam — S, A, M.
sentences.target: Sure. My name is Sam — S, A, M.

sentences.en: Nice to meet you, Sam. The English alphabet has twenty-six letters.
sentences.target: Nice to meet you, Sam. The English alphabet has twenty-six letters.

sentences.en: It starts with A, B, C, D, E and ends with X, Y, Z.
sentences.target: It starts with A, B, C, D, E and ends with X, Y, Z.

sentences.en: How is the weather today? Is it hot or cold?
sentences.target: How is the weather today? Is it hot or cold?

sentences.en: Today it is sunny and warm. It's a beautiful day.
sentences.target: Today it is sunny and warm. It's a beautiful day.

sentences.en: Yesterday it was cloudy and a little cold.
sentences.target: Yesterday it was cloudy and a little cold.

sentences.en: Tomorrow it might rain, so please bring an umbrella.
sentences.target: Tomorrow it might rain, so please bring an umbrella.

sentences.en: I love sunny days. They make me happy.
sentences.target: I love sunny days. They make me happy.
